decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the selection based on battery life, durability for outdoor use, and sound output relative to price. The consideration set includes a high-end option from Bose (prod_bluetooth_speakers_137) and several well-rated mid-range portable speakers from INSMY, JBL, EDUPLINK, and Altec Lansing. I ultimately chose the INSMY Portable Bluetooth Speaker (prod_bluetooth_speakers_128) because it offers an impressive 24-hour battery life and 20W power output at a highly competitive price of $29.99, backed by a strong 4.6-star rating from over 6,000 reviews.
